authorization.text: 授权修复并上线 v0.7.6，修复后在这个 Canvas 再真实执行一次。
authorization.versionConvention: Ordinary patch release v0.7.6; no hotfix suffix.

rootCause: The bounded native-video continuation terminalized a still-recoverable accepted Provider task as failed/RESULT_DELAYED.
The workflow service treated that premature task failure as decisive, blocked the downstream consistency node, and released the run before the same Provider task succeeded.
Authoritative server projection omitted the five durable group-run success proof fields required by browser recovery.
Authoritative video projection omitted videoWidth and videoHeight, allowing metadata hydration to create another avoidable save.

fix: Transition a delayed accepted native video to recovering/AUTOMATIC_RESULT_RECOVERY while preserving task, attempt and providerTaskId.
Keep the workflow node admitted and the run locked while the original generation task remains recoverable; settle the same run after that task succeeds.
Validate task input, ownership, model-configuration and model-release identities before authoritative projection.
Write all five groupRunSuccess proof fields, a browser-compatible result fingerprint, and video dimensions in the server projection.

verification.safeM103ServerWorkflow: Final 11/11 PASS; recovering task keeps run/lock/reservation active, then same task success completes the run and releases resources; authoritative success proof is complete.

verification.formalFull: 124/124 specs executed; 1178/1179 PASS. The sole failure was m94's stale package-version regex, which accepted 0.5.2 and 0.6.x but not 0.7.6; every product test passed.
verification.postFullAffectedFix: Expanded only the m94 release-snapshot version assertion to the established 0.7.x line; targeted m94 rerun 4/4 PASS, failed/skipped/retries/blocked/reportErrors all 0.
verification.retainedIntermediateEvidence: The first expanded m103 fixture run was 10/11 because the synthetic recovering task was created before singleton startup recovery and was correctly treated as abandoned. The fixture was corrected to initialize the runtime store first; product code did not change for that fixture-only failure. The formal full result and its one stale test assertion remain recorded; the full suite was not repeated after the test-only correction.
